title: Taxonomies: Categorize Your Content | Orchard Core
description:
Almost every site groups its content: posts by topic, products by type. When editors type categories by hand, one topic ends up under several names, and visitors can't browse by topic.

The Taxonomies module manages categories and tags as taxonomies of terms, organized as a hierarchy. A Taxonomy Field attaches the terms to your content, and the site can list the content of each term.

In this video:
